bluf: Russian deep strikes on Ukrainian energy targets and Hormuz tanker attacks will continue at elevated tempo through the week, sustaining outages and insurance spikes. Houthi pressure on Saudi targets and Bab el-Mandeb shipping lanes forms the single biggest near-term risk of rapid escalation and rerouting costs.

forecasts.event: UKMTO or gCaptain reports at least one additional unknown-projectile strike on a commercial vessel in the Black Sea EEZ
basis: ongoing drone attacks on Alfa Watan and Able
forecasts.watch_for: first UKMTO or Bulgarian maritime authority notice
forecasts.wrong_if: no new vessel incident reported by 08 Oct 23:59 UTC

forecasts.event: Houthi ballistic missile or drone achieves confirmed hit on Saudi airport or oil facility
basis: recent strikes on Abha and Riyadh area
forecasts.watch_for: Saudi MoD or Houthi statement claiming impact
forecasts.wrong_if: all incoming projectiles intercepted with no confirmed damage

forecasts.event: Ukrainian General Staff confirms long-range strike on Russian energy target beyond Samara
forecasts.watch_for: Russian MoD or milblogger footage of new fire
forecasts.wrong_if: no new Russian energy facility incident confirmed

forecasts.event: Saudi-backed forces announce capture of additional territory within 20 km of Bab el-Mandeb
forecasts.wrong_if: front line static with no new gains claimed

forecasts.event: Ethiopian federal or TPLF issues public statement on Eritrean troop numbers in Tigray
forecasts.wrong_if: no statement issued by 10 Oct 23:59 UTC

forecasts.event: Taiwan MND reports single-day PLA total exceeding 25 aircraft sorties
Russian strikes cause cumulative >100 civilian casualties across multiple cities
forecasts.watch_for: Ukrainska Pravda or Kyiv Independent cumulative toll

forecasts.event: Insurance premium advisory for Hormuz or Bab el-Mandeb transits rises by at least 15 percent
forecasts.watch_for: first maritime insurer or gCaptain advisory
